description: This file contains helper functions and data structures related to Wizard steps and options within a larger application. It manages encoding/decoding data, parsing options, and utility functions for data type conversions.

classes.name: WizardOption
classes.description: A structure representing a wizard option with a value, label, and optional hint, conforming to Sendable for concurrency safety.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object by encoding it to JSON and then decoding.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Parses a list of dictionaries into an array of WizardOption objects, extracting value, label, and hint.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a trimmed and lowercased string if possible.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Retrieves the 'type' string from a WizardStep object.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a string representation.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to an array of AnyCodable.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Checks equality between two AnyCodable values.
